items.title: Will Bank of America's Swiss Expansion Fuel Further Fee Income Growth?
items.summary: BAC's Swiss expansion is driving rapid client growth and broader European capabilities, potentially boosting cross-border opportunities and fee income.

items.title: JPMorgan Rethinks UK Investments: Will Higher Taxes Hurt Growth?
items.summary: JPM reconsiders major U.K. investments as rising banking taxes threaten profitability, raising concerns over future expansion and long-term earnings growth.
